source_candidate_binding.display_candidate: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents (CASS + u-SMCO)

primary_source.title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
primary_source.status: very recent primary study; no protocol-matched independent reproduction located in this audit

cass_method.paper_definition: CASS draws N distinct coalitions; coalition size is uniform on {1,...,k}, coalition is uniform among subsets of that size; it scores normalized group knockout loss (V(B)-V(B\S))/|S|, averages the N margins, then adds lambda=0.2 times online outcome reward and uses the baseline best-so-far gate.
cass_method.scope_correction: The paper explicitly says CASS retains the coalition view but abandons per-skill attribution. It is therefore not a conventional per-skill Shapley-value estimator even though the abstract describes sampled Shapley marginals.
cass_method.reported_budget: The experiment section says CASS adds eight coalition evaluations per outer epoch, about 5% of a 20-hour run; this supports N=8 operationally in the reported setup. The visible paper does not expose the numerical coalition-size cap k.

usmco_method.paper_definition: u-SMCO rebuilds target-context memory under skill knockouts, scores retrieval quality on unlabeled target queries, greedily masks the minimum-score skill, and stops when the minimum knockout score is at least threshold tau.
usmco_method.reported_cost: O(K^2) memory rebuilds, 6-10 minutes per mask step in the authors' setup; Table 4 uses an unlabeled 20-query target probe.
usmco_method.replay_gap: The visible paper gives tau symbolically but not its numerical value; raw 20-query probe contents, bank snapshots, embedding outputs and trained checkpoints were not publicly located.

mechanistic_scope.coalition_pollution: The baseline transition B3->B4 is accepted on online margin +0.006 while the newly admitted capture_activity_preferences has audited full-bank marginal -0.005 and incumbent insert has +0.084.
mechanistic_scope.audit_resolution: The paper states gate margins are 0.006-0.02, reward SE is about 0.004, and a single-skill audit on 314 paired queries resolves contribution only to about +/-0.04.
mechanistic_scope.cross_domain_reversal: insert is +0.084 on LoCoMo with CI excluding zero and -0.035 point estimate on HotpotQA with target CI including zero. This is directional reversal evidence, not statistically significant target harm.

independent_mechanical_checks.interpretation: Published table arithmetic is internally consistent. This is a mechanical reconstruction of displayed numbers, not an independent rerun of the agent experiments.

artifact_and_replication_audit.official_release_status: The paper states in future tense that the audit toolkit, method code, and trained checkpoints will be released. The arXiv article page currently exposes paper/HTML/TeX links but no author code/data repository. Exact-title and CASS/u-SMCO GitHub repository searches returned no repository during this audit.
missing_for_exact_replay: exact random seeds and sampled coalition identities for each gate decision
numerical k used for coalition-size sampling
raw target 20-query probes/contexts and embedding outputs
raw bank-level and knockout evaluation outputs
environment/container/dependency lock sufficient to reproduce the full 8xH20 runs
artifact_and_replication_audit.appendix_gap: The HTML/body cites Appendix A.1/A.3/C.1 and Algorithm A1, but the currently inspectable article body does not expose all replay-critical parameter values. TeX source was not inspectable through the current retrieval path; this is a retrieval limitation, not a claim that the source is globally unavailable.
artifact_and_replication_audit.independent_reproduction_search: No protocol-matched third-party rerun of CASS/u-SMCO was located. Given the paper was submitted four days before this audit, absence of a matched rerun is unsurprising and is not negative evidence against the method.

supported: The paper provides coherent primary-study evidence that coalition-conditioned skill-bank auditing can expose outcome-gate failures and that the authors' CASS/u-SMCO interventions improved the reported matched experiments.
CASS is best described as a bounded bank-level coalition-knockout gate, not full per-skill Shapley attribution.
The target-domain insert result is a directional sign reversal with uncertainty, not proven harmful transfer.
The displayed aggregate arithmetic is independently reconstructible from the published tables.
not_supported: independent reproduction of the reported gains
exact replay of the gate or masking decisions
a claim that N=8 alone fully specifies CASS without k, coalition draws, probe/evaluator state and seeds
a claim that u-SMCO universally improves transferred banks outside the six reported bank instances
a claim that retrieval-quality correlation proves causal target utility in arbitrary domains

reopen_conditions: official code/checkpoints and exact run configuration are released
k, tau, seeds, sampled coalitions, target probes and bank snapshots become publicly recoverable
a correction/version materially changes the method or reported tables
a matched ablation separates coalition sampling, outcome-score mixing and u-SMCO proxy choices under the same budget
